feature_descriptions.amount_to_sender_avg: Current amount divided by sender average amount
feature_descriptions.amount_z_score: Z-score of current amount relative to historical
feature_descriptions.amount_deviation_from_baseline_30d: Z-score of current amount relative to 30-day historical mean
feature_descriptions.sender_volume_24h: Total transaction volume in last 24 hours
feature_descriptions.same_day_count: Number of transactions on same day
feature_descriptions.rapid_transfer_count: Count of rapid transfers (inbound to outbound within 1 hour)
feature_descriptions.is_new_recipient: Binary flag if recipient is new to sender
feature_descriptions.unique_recipients_7d: Number of unique recipients in last 7 days
feature_descriptions.is_off_hours: Binary flag if transaction is outside business hours
feature_descriptions.counterparty_change_score_7d: Jaccard similarity between current 7d and previous 7d receiver sets

label_independence: All features are label-independent - no use of ground_truth_label, scenario_id, or any target-derived variable
